name: 01_testConnection
description: testConnection sync action against the Shoptet OpenAPI mock server with a dummy private token.

name: 02_listStocks
description: listStocks sync action — populates the Stock dropdown from /api/stocks.

name: 04_listIncludeSections
description: listIncludeSections sync action for object=orders — must return the six documented snapshot sections without any HTTP call (registry lookup only).

name: 07_brands_paginated
description: FetchMode.PAGINATED — /api/brands, keyed on guid (regression coverage for the ba828e5 fix: the list response has no `code` field at all).

name: 08_stocks_list
description: FetchMode.LIST — /api/stocks, single response carrying the whole array.

name: 09_customer_groups_list
description: FetchMode.LIST — /api/customers/groups, keyed on id (regression coverage for the ba828e5 fix: there is no `guid` field on this response).

name: 10_eshop_single
description: FetchMode.SINGLE — /api/eshop, one settings record with an empty primary key by design (always fully overwritten).

name: 11_stock_movements_per_stock_all
description: FetchMode.PER_STOCK fanned out over every stock — stock_id left empty so the component first resolves stock ids from /api/stocks, then reads /api/stocks/{id}/movements.

name: 12_stock_movements_per_stock_pinned
description: FetchMode.PER_STOCK pinned to one stock via stock_id — skips the /api/stocks lookup and reads /api/stocks/1/movements directly.

name: 13_variant_parameters_child_tables
description: Child-table split: variant_parameters' nested `values` array becomes variant_parameters_values.csv keyed by parameter_id + row_number (extract_child_tables=true, the default).

name: 14_variant_parameters_inline_json
description: Same object with extract_child_tables=false — the `values` array must stay inline as a JSON-string column and no _values child table should be produced.

name: 17_missing_credentials
description: Failure: no #private_api_token and no OAuth pair — Credentials validation must reject before any HTTP call.

name: 18_missing_object
description: Failure: valid credentials but no `object` selected on the row — Configuration validation must reject before the registry is even consulted.

name: 19_unknown_include_section
description: Failure: `include` names a section orders does not support — must be rejected before any fetch happens (zero HTTP interactions expected).

name: 20_addon_oauth_missing_token_url
description: Failure: addon_oauth auth type with an OAuth access token but no oauth_token_url — Credentials validation must reject both being required together.

name: 21_stock_supplies_per_stock
description: FetchMode.PER_STOCK for stock_supplies — the direct replacement for the old permalink component's stock CSV export, so it gets its own coverage rather than being represented by stock_movements. Its primary key includes a `code` field, which is exactly why this must be recorded through tests/setup/record_code_safe.py: the VCR baseline sanitizer would otherwise redact the primary key and guarantee a replay mismatch.
